test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Ria’s mother equally divided the chocolates__ among __both her daughters.
solution:
The correct answer is **"between"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Between" **is used when referring to two people or things.
 
• **"Among" **is used when referring to three or more people or things.
 
• In this sentence, there are only two daughters, so **"between" **is the correct option.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amongst: **This option is also incorrect because **"amongst" **is a less commonly used variant of **"among."**
 
• **Among: **This option is incorrect because it is used when referring to three or more people or things, and there are only two daughters in this sentence.
